name: webapp-recorder
description: Scripted, narrated screen recordings of any logged-in web app — describe clicks/fills in plain labels, no DOM inspection or codegen session required.

scripts.tts:setup: python3 -m venv .tts-venv && .tts-venv/bin/pip install --quiet piper-tts && mkdir -p tts-models && curl -sL -o tts-models/en_US-lessac-high.onnx https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices/resolve/main/en/en_US/lessac/high/en_US-lessac-high.onnx && curl -sL -o tts-models/en_US-lessac-high.onnx.json https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices/resolve/main/en/en_US/lessac/high/en_US-lessac-high.onnx.json && echo 'Piper ready — set "tts": "piper" in your flow JSON.'
scripts.tts:setup:kokoro: command -v python3.13 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'Needs Python 3.13 (kokoro-onnx does not yet support 3.14) — install with: brew install python@3.13'; exit 1; } && python3.13 -m venv .tts-venv-kokoro && .tts-venv-kokoro/bin/pip install --quiet 'git+https://github.com/thewh1teagle/kokoro-onnx.git@main' soundfile && mkdir -p tts-models && curl -sL -o tts-models/kokoro-v1.0.onnx https://github.com/thewh1teagle/kokoro-onnx/releases/download/model-files-v1.1/kokoro-v1.0.onnx && curl -sL -o tts-models/voices-v1.0.bin https://github.com/thewh1teagle/kokoro-onnx/releases/download/model-files-v1.1/voices-v1.0.bin && echo 'Kokoro ready — set "tts": "kokoro" in your flow JSON.'
